pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Cloud-Veined Silver Crystal forms upon towering mountains, where thin clouds and powerful winds carry pure spiritual energy. Its silver-white body contains delicate patterns resembling drifting clouds. These crystals favor lofty peaks and windswept ridges far above the lowlands.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Search jagged, frozen, and stony peaks, as well as windswept hills and forests, between Y 80 and 256.
